claim: This configuration selects NeverNegative as an invariant to check. It makes no claim about the outcome of that check.
proposition: This configuration enables the NeverNegative invariant, directly or through an alias.

artifact.source:
EXTENDS Integers
VARIABLE balance
Init == balance = 0
Next == balance' \in -1..1
TypeOK == balance \in Int
NeverNegative == balance >= 0
AuditInvariant == NeverNegative
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_balance
